items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: So then Arthur went to work with Lena, and I only worked on that job about two and a half weeks.

ctx.x: So then Arthur went to work with Lena, and I only worked on that job about two and a half weeks. We had a six weeks contract there, because Lena was going to be there six weeks, see, and as I said, we were an intermission group, and we were well received. It was just wonderful, and we met a lot of people, you know, important people at that time, and I would say it was one of the most important jobs that we had had. It was really, because it was in Hollywood and the other jobs were not in Hollywood, see.
Well, it was on the Sunset Strip, and the Sunset Strip at that point was a very prestigious location.
